definitions.explanation: Points awarded for match results in a league table — typically three for a win and one for a draw in soccer. The team with the most {勝|か}ち{点|てん}, not the most wins, tops the table.

examples.japanese: {勝|か}ち{点|てん}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{三|さん}→三：00749_san⟧⟦{増|ふ}えた→増える：01183_fueru⟧。
⟦{引|ひ}き{分|わ}け→引き分け：04907_hikiwake⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦も→も：00484_mo⟧{勝|か}ち{点|てん}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{一|いち}→一：00705_ichi⟧⟦もらえる→もらう：00520_morau⟧。
examples.english: You get one point even for a draw.

examples.japanese: ⟦{残|のこ}り→残り：01622_nokori⟧⟦{二|に}→二：00736_ni⟧⟦{試合|しあい}→試合：01601_shiai⟧で{勝|か}ち{点|てん}⟦{六|ろく}→六：00747_roku⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{取|と}れば→取る：00565_toru⟧、⟦{優勝|ゆうしょう}→優勝：03647_yuushou⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{決|き}まる→決まる：01233_kimaru⟧。
examples.english: If they take six points from the remaining two matches, the title is theirs.

notes:
COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {勝|か}ち{点|てん}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{取|と}る→取る：00565_toru⟧: to take points
- {勝|か}ち{点|てん}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{積|つ}み{上|あ}げる→積み上げる：07920_tsumiageru⟧: to pile up points
- {勝|か}ち{点|てん}⟦{差|さ}→差：02771_sa⟧: the points gap between teams
- {勝|か}ち{点|てん}⟦{三|さん}→三：00749_san⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{手|て}→手：00569_te⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧: to secure three points (a win)

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{得点|とくてん}→得点：04909_tokuten⟧: goals or points scored within a game — not standings points
- {勝|か}ち{星|ぼし}: a win mark — used in sumo and baseball, where wins rather than points decide the ranking
